name: CKEditor5 Bootstrap Integration
description: CKEditor 5 widgets for Bootstrap 5: Bootstrap Div (class/id/attributes/background image), Bootstrap Table (caption + table classes), and Bootstrap Components (accordion, card, carousel, modal, tabs, etc.).
project_description: Provides three CKEditor 5 plugins that let editors author Bootstrap 5 markup from a rich-text toolbar: a Bootstrap Div widget (choose utility/layout classes, an id, a background image, AOS animation attributes, and arbitrary data-*/aria-* attributes), a Bootstrap Table widget (a balloon toolbar to add a caption and toggle table-* classes such as table-striped/bordered/hover/responsive), and a Bootstrap Components widget (insert prebuilt Accordion, Alert, Badge, Card, Carousel, Collapse, List group, Modal, Offcanvas, Toast, Tooltip, Popover, and Tabs snippets). The button lists and component templates are driven by bundled JSON config files (components_config.json, bootstrap-config.json, table_options.json) that site builders can override per plugin with a custom JSON path; no PHP changes are needed to add classes or components. Best paired with a Bootstrap 5 theme. Depends on core CKEditor 5 and Editor; adds no routes, permissions, services, or Drush commands.
